9
Diamond is extremely hard and does not conduct electricity.
Which statement explains these properties?
A
It has positive carbon ions surrounded by delocalised electrons.
B
It has strong ionic bonds between each carbon atom.
C
It has delocalised electrons, and each carbon atom forms three covalent bonds with other
carbon atoms.
D
It has no delocalised electrons, and each carbon atom forms four covalent bonds with other
carbon atoms.
